title: Can Investors Profit from the Prophets? Security Analyst Recommendations and Stock Returns
one_line: Buying the most-recommended stocks and shorting the least-recommended earned >4%/yr gross (1986-1996), but high turnover and costs wipe it out unless rebalanced infrequently.

findings.statement: Top-minus-bottom consensus portfolio > 4% annual abnormal return gross.
Net of transaction costs the abnormal returns are not reliably positive.

reported_results.headline: Buying the most-recommended stocks and shorting the least-recommended earned >4%/yr gross (1986-1996), but high turnover and costs wipe it out unless rebalanced infrequently.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
